bibliographic.title: Lecoq : Investigations in Paris 1900
bibliographic.author: Soren
bibliographic.description:
A deduction and investigation game for desktop computer or mobile (play in browser), inspired by the 1981 board game "Sherlock Holmes : Consulting Detective".

Explore Paris during the Belle Époque with police officer Lecoq, the French counterpart to Sherlock Holmes. Question witnesses and suspects, search locations on map and archives, find clues in newspapers. Connect the clues, dismiss false leads to solve criminal cases…
